acf.procut: Metal Jacketed Gasket Manufacturer for Heat Exchangers & Flanges A metal jacketed gasket is a precision-engineered sealing solution designed for applications that demand exceptional strength, temperature resistance, and long-term reliability. Constructed with a soft filler core enclosed in a metallic outer shell, this gasket type delivers superior compressibility while maintaining structural integrity under extreme pressure and thermal cycling. Asian Sealing Products Pvt. Ltd. is a trusted manufacturer of metal jacketed gaskets delivering high-integrity sealing solutions for applications involving elevated temperatures, high bolt loads, and aggressive process media. Our metal jacketed gaskets are engineered with a precision-formed metallic outer shell that fully encloses a resilient filler core, ensuring controlled compression, excellent recovery, and superior resistance to gasket blowout in critical flange assemblies. We manufacture single-jacketed, double-jacketed, and corrugated metal-jacketed gaskets for demanding applications such as heat exchangers, pressure vessels, boilers, and refinery piping systems. Each gasket is produced in accordance with ASME B16.20 standards, with full material traceability, dimensional accuracy, and application-specific customization to meet project specifications. Designed for reliability, thermal stability, and long service life, our metal jacketed gaskets ensure leak-free performance across oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, and process industries.

key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt.key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt_content: The reinforced metal jacket contains the filler core and prevents extrusion under high internal pressure, maintaining dimensional stability during severe pressure cycling.
Heat-resistant jacket materials allow reliable sealing under sustained high temperatures and rapid thermal fluctuations, from cryogenic service to elevated-temperature operation.
Jacket alloys and filler materials are selected to withstand corrosive media such as acids, alkalis, hydrocarbons, and mixed chemical streams.
The compressible filler conforms to uneven or aged flange surfaces, ensuring consistent sealing where surface finish control is limited.
Metal jacketed gaskets can be manufactured in large diameters and complex profiles, including pass partition bar designs for heat exchanger applications.

acf.application_description: A metal jacketed gasket is widely specified for heavy-duty industrial sealing applications where operating pressures, elevated temperatures, and high mechanical loads exceed the capabilities of conventional soft gaskets. Its reinforced metal shell and resilient filler core provide superior blowout resistance, structural stability, and long-term sealing reliability under demanding service conditions. Metal jacketed gaskets can be custom-manufactured in large diameters, pass-partition designs, and complex geometries, making them essential for critical equipment such as heat exchangers, boilers, pressure vessels, and reactor systems. Their adaptability ensures effective sealing even in applications involving thermal cycling, flange distortion, and aggressive process media. Designed in accordance with ASME standards, metal jacketed gaskets are extensively used across industries, where leak prevention, operational safety, and regulatory compliance are non-negotiable.

acf.gaskets_materials_descriptions: To ensure dependable sealing performance, metal jacketed gaskets are manufactured using a composite construction that combines mechanical strength with controlled compressibility. The metal jacket functions as a protective outer shell, delivering structural support while acting as the primary barrier against process media and elevated pressures. Jacket materials are selected based on service conditions and commonly include Stainless Steel, Carbon Steel, and Monel to meet specific chemical and thermal requirements. Enclosed within the jacket, the filler core provides the necessary resilience and recovery to conform to flange surfaces and maintain a secure seal. Filler materials such as flexible graphite, PTFE, or ceramic help accommodate thermal expansion, vibration, and mechanical movement during operation. Below is the complete list of available materials and their specific performance characteristics:

gaskets_materials_types.gaskets_materials_types_content: An economical choice for general non-corrosive steam and oil services, suitable for temperatures up to 500°C.
The industry standard for chemical and food processing, offering high corrosion resistance at temperatures up to 550°C (with 321/347 reaching 800°C).
Soft and highly malleable materials ideal for uneven flange faces or air compressors, rated for temperatures between 300°C and 400°C.
Provides exceptional resistance to hydrofluoric acid and marine environments, maintaining integrity up to 500°C.
Engineered for the most demanding environments, providing superior oxidation resistance in extreme heat up to 1000°C.
A lightweight, corrosion-resistant option often used in specialized gas applications with temperatures up to 300°C.
The most popular choice due to its wide temperature range (-200°C to 550°C) and excellent chemical resistance.
Used specifically for high-purity or highly aggressive chemical environments where temperature remains below 260°C.
Reserved for extremely high-temperature applications (up to 1100°C) where other fillers would degrade.
A cost-effective, general-purpose filler used for heat insulation and lower-pressure sealing up to 500°C.

acf.gaskets_types_descriptions: Asian Sealing manufactures precision-engineered metal jacketed gasket types designed to perform under real-world operating conditions, including bolt load variation, thermal cycling, flange misalignment, and surface irregularities. The range includes single jacketed gaskets for moderate-pressure duties, double jacketed gaskets for higher-pressure and heat exchanger applications, and corrugated metal gaskets for improved flexibility under fluctuating loads. Each gasket configuration is developed to achieve the optimal balance between structural rigidity and compressibility, ensuring stable, leak-free sealing in high-temperature and high-pressure environments.

acf.faq_title: Answers to all your possible questions.

faq_content.faq_question: What is a metal jacketed gasket?
faq_content.faq_answer: A metal jacketed gasket is a semi-metallic sealing solution consisting of a soft filler core fully or partially enclosed in a metallic outer shell. The metal jacket provides strength and blowout resistance, while the filler ensures compressibility and recovery for effective flange sealing.

faq_content.faq_question: Where are metal jacketed gaskets commonly used?
faq_content.faq_answer: Metal jacketed gaskets are primarily used in heat exchangers, boilers, pressure vessels, reactor systems, and refinery piping. They are ideal for high-temperature, high-pressure applications where conventional soft gaskets may fail.

faq_content.faq_question: What are the types of metal jacketed gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer:
The main types include:
1. Single jacketed gaskets for moderate pressure services
2. Double jacketed gaskets for higher-pressure and heat exchanger applications
3. Corrugated metal jacketed gaskets for improved flexibility under fluctuating loads

faq_content.faq_question: What standards govern metal jacketed gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: Metal jacketed gaskets are typically manufactured in accordance with ASME B16.20, DIN, and API standards , ensuring dimensional accuracy, pressure class compliance, and material traceability.

faq_content.faq_question: How do I choose the right metal jacketed gasket material for corrosive media?
faq_content.faq_answer: Material selection depends on process media, operating temperature, and pressure conditions. Stainless steel and Monel jackets are commonly used for corrosive environments, while filler materials such as flexible graphite or PTFE enhance chemical resistance. Our engineering team supports the selection of metal jacketed gasket materials based on specific service requirements.

faq_content.faq_question: Are your metal jacketed gaskets compliant with international standards?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes. Asian Sealing manufactures ASME B16.20 metal jacketed gaskets and supplies products compliant with ASME B16.5 and ASME B16.47 flange standards. All gaskets are produced under certified quality systems with full material traceability for global industrial and oil & gas applications.

faq_content.faq_question: What temperature and pressure ranges can metal jacketed gaskets withstand?
faq_content.faq_answer: Performance depends on material selection. With appropriate materials, metal jacketed gaskets can operate in temperatures exceeding 500°C and in high-pressure flange assemblies used in refinery and power generation systems.

faq_content.faq_question: How do metal jacketed gaskets differ from spiral wound gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: Metal jacketed gaskets use a solid metal shell with a soft core, offering rigidity and suitability for heat exchanger and pass-partition applications. Spiral wound gaskets use alternating layers of metal winding and filler, making them more flexible and suitable for pipeline flanges.

faq_content.faq_question: How long do metal jacketed gaskets last?
faq_content.faq_answer: Service life depends on operating conditions, but with proper installation and maintenance, they provide long-term sealing performance.

faq_content.faq_question: How should metal jacketed gaskets be installed?
faq_content.faq_answer: Ensure clean flange surfaces, correct alignment, and uniform bolt tightening to prevent leakage.

faq_content.faq_question: Can metal jacketed gaskets be customized?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes. Metal jacketed gaskets can be custom-manufactured in large diameters, non-standard shapes, and pass-partition designs to match specific flange configurations and operating requirements.
